programs.name: VA health care and veterans benefits
programs.message: Veterans may be able to get VA health care, including substance use and mental health treatment. Check with the VA — it's free to ask.

links.label: Veterans Crisis Line: dial 988 then press 1

programs.name: Peer recovery support near you
programs.message: Peer recovery centers, meetings, and recovery coaches are free. See local options in our resource finder, or reach out to Root to Rise.

programs.name: Massachusetts Health Connector
programs.message: If you don't have insurance and MassHealth isn't a fit, the Health Connector may offer low-cost plans with help paying premiums.

programs.name: HealthCare.gov (New Hampshire)
programs.message: If you don't have insurance and Medicaid isn't a fit, HealthCare.gov may offer low-cost plans with help paying premiums.

programs.name: SSI (Supplemental Security Income)
programs.message: SSI pays monthly cash to people with very low income and resources who are 65+, blind, or have a disability. Social Security decides — check with them.
